label: PF Backlog 568
title: Local dev auth: self-configuring PF API <-> worker token + dev launcher (no manual env)
body:
## Problem / why
Local `wg work` fails with 401 unless the operator manually sets API_TOKEN on BOTH the PF API server and the
worker client (or API_ALLOW_ANON on the server). The two processes never share a local credential and there is
no dev launcher, so it is a manual dance and the running API can end up with neither token nor anon (rejects all).

## Goal & value
Local dev "just works": one command starts the API with a shared, gitignored dev token that the worker reads
automatically. Prod stays fail-closed.

## Implementation (Option A)
- `core/dev_auth.py`: gitignored dev token at `data/local/dev-api-token` (auto-generated, 0600); `is_dev()` gated by `PF_DEV=1`.
- `api/auth.py`: `_token()` falls back to the dev token file **only when `PF_DEV=1`** (prod unaffected).
- `scripts/dev/dev_server.py`: ensures the token, sets `PF_DEV=1` + `API_TOKEN`, runs `uvicorn api.app:app` on 127.0.0.1.
- `workergrid/client.py`: generic `token_file` config fallback (env unset) - keeps WorkerGrid producer-agnostic.
- `workergrid/config.json`: `token_file` -> the dev token.
- `.gitignore`: ignore `product-forge/data/local/`.
- docs: WORKER-SCHEDULER-OPERATIONS.md + ENTRYPOINTS.md.

## Acceptance (G/W/T)
- Given `PF_DEV=1` and no API_TOKEN, when the API starts via the launcher, then a worker reading the dev token
  file authenticates (no manual env).
- Given prod (no PF_DEV), then the API stays fail-closed (no file fallback).

## Risks
Weakens auth if misused -> gated by PF_DEV=1 + gitignored; never in prod.
